chosen_on: Keele liver only (cis-eQTL scan genes, 7,810; tail = resvar_hybrid/resvar_salmon_pan > 2, 9.28%). No other cohort's tail was looked at before this file was written.

primary_flag.name: low unique fraction
primary_flag.definition: u_g = frac_emg = (gene's variant-free probe windows that are gene-unique and single-copy in GRCm38, i.e. the frozen emg rule) / (all variant-free probe windows in the gene's annotated transcripts); computed on the layout's own EM design (26 nt for 50 bp; 76 nt for 100/101 bp)

secondary_design_model.name: compact logistic
secondary_design_model.fit: all Keele liver genes, standardised, C=1
secondary_design_model.threshold: score quantile flagging 15% of liver genes

secondary_postcount_model.name: compact logistic + log(T) + observed EM branch (truth-free, Salmon-free, known after counting)

metrics_out_of_sample: ROC AUC and PR AUC of the score
flag rate, precision, recall, tail rate flagged vs unflagged
median and mean per-gene resvar ratio and per-gene animal factor for unflagged genes
detection-matched extra-n for unflagged genes where per-sample data allow
ceiling_reference: the observed liver tail itself used as a flag for other cohorts (gene overlap only)
